failure_modes.name: Evidence_Present_But_Missed
failure_modes.evidence: Summary_2 states 'While passage [1] identifies H. G. Wells as the author of "Love and Mr Lewisham," it provides no information about his nationality or award status. More critically, there is no passage about Rubén Darío in the provided materials at all.' However, hop 1 passages clearly establish Rubén Darío as Nicaraguan (passages 1-3), and hop 3 passage 'The Story of a Great Schoolmaster' identifies H. G. Wells as author with British contextual markers (his sons attended Oundle School, University College London). The solver missed this available evidence.

failure_modes.name: Multi_Hop_Context_Degradation
failure_modes.evidence: Summary_1 (after hop 1) correctly states 'the passages confirm that Rubén Darío was a Nicaraguan poet (not English)', but Summary_2 (after hop 2) claims 'there is no passage about Rubén Darío in the provided materials at all.' The solver lost track of information established in the first hop by the time it reached the second hop analysis.

failure_modes.name: Query_Form_Mismatch
failure_modes.evidence: The query after hop 2 is 'H. G. Wells English author awards biography' — an unstructured keyword soup with no clear target entity or natural phrasing that a retriever can effectively use.

failure_modes.name: Missing_Evidence_Not_Specified
failure_modes.evidence: Summary_2 states the need for 'A passage about H. G. Wells establishing his nationality (whether he was English) and documenting his award-winning status' but does not name the specific missing entity concretely enough for targeted retrieval (e.g., 'H. G. Wells biography' or 'H. G. Wells nationality and awards'). The summary mentions needs but without precise documentary targets.
